subject: Request: approval for Custom Integration + Subscriber Support concession
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Park <jessica@cloudline.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Custom integration + Subscriber Support: proposed scope and pricing

Jessica —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion, attached is the SOW (v3) and the pricing breakdown for the integration and the premium "Subscriber Support" add-on you asked about. Key points in the proposed package:

- Custom SSO connector and one bespoke webhook integration (estimated 4 weeks dev + 2 weeks QA)
- Subscriber Support (24/7) included for first 6 months
- Onboarding services (kickoff, runbooks, 2 onsite/remote sessions) included in the one-time onboarding fee
- List price: $250,000 first-year ARR (includes first-year support & onboarding)

If you want to move forward we can draft the order form and get legal to issue an addendum to the SOW. I attached the SOW-Cloudline-v3.pdf and pricing-breakdown-CL.xlsx for your procurement team.

Happy to jump on a call if you want to walk the numbers.

Best,
Olga
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-1212

Attachments:
- SOW-Cloudline-v3.pdf (SOW v3, marked with estimated milestones)
- pricing-breakdown-CL.xlsx (line-item pricing, T&C notes)

From: Jessica Park <jessica@cloudline.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cloudline Procurement <procure@cloudline.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Custom integration + Subscriber Support: proposed scope and pricing

Olga —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear SOW. A few asks from procurement/executive team before we can sign: 

1) Can Redwood waive the onboarding fee? We have internal constraints on capital this quarter and would prefer it rolled into the subscription.
2) Can you include 3 months of concierge support (dedicated TAM/onboarding engineer) rather than 6 months?
3) We are requesting a 20% first-year discount to align with our budgeted spend.

Our procurement deadline is end of next week — we need an exec sign-off on concessions to approve the PO. If you can confirm concessions and get legal redlines back within 48 hours, we can execute quickly.

Thanks,
Jessica Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
Cloudline AI
jessica@cloudline.ai

Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: escalation request — Cloudline concession ask (20% discount + waive onboarding)

Team —

Forwarding Cloudline's ask (see below). They want: 20% first-year discount, waive onboarding fee (roll into ARR), and reduce concierge from 6 -> 3 months. They have a procurement cutoff next Friday and have signaled they will execute immediately if we approve.

Impact: at list price we are $250k ARR. A 20% discount reduces first-year ARR to $200k; we would also lose the one-time onboarding fee (~$25k). Net concession roughly $75k in year-one revenue and ~$20k in gross margin depending on final install hours. They are strategic for our Marketplaces vertical and could become a reference if we move quickly.

Options I propose:
- Option A (preferred): Approve a 15% first-year discount, waive onboarding fee, include concierge support for 90 days (concierge = named TAM + 4 onboarding sessions). Require 12-month committed term and standard ELA.
- Option B: Hold list price, waive onboarding fee only, include 60 days concierge; offer 10% discount only if they sign a 24-month commit.

Requesting Marcus' approval for Option A or direction to send Option B. Legal needs a shot to redline the SOW if we proceed. Documents attached: SOW-Cloudline-v3.pdf, pricing-breakdown-CL.xlsx (see tab 'Concessions').

Thanks,
Olga

Attachments:
- SOW-Cloudline-v3.pdf
- pricing-breakdown-CL.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: escalation request — Cloudline concession ask (20% discount + waive onboarding)

Thanks for the context, Olga.

I approve Option A with the following conditions: 
- Approve a 15% first-year discount (not 20%).
- Waive the onboarding fee and include a 90-day concierge package (named TAM + four onboarding sessions).
- Require a 12-month committed term and include an annual ELA with standard support SLAs.
- Cap the total concession exposure to $25,000 in first-year gross margin impact; if our margin estimate exceeds this, return to me with the adjusted numbers.

Please proceed: have Legal and Finance prepare the redlined SOW and order form (adjust pricing in pricing-breakdown-CL.xlsx). Update HubSpot deal D-48291-CL with the concession details and attach the redline. Once legal has the amended SOW, I will countersign the executive approval.

Marcus
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
